t: A free browser 3D robot simulator programmed with Blockly or Python.
steps: Find Gears at the hosted site and open the GearsBot tutorials.
Check that student browsers support WebGL.
Open the site on a Chromebook or computer.
Run the first tutorial with Blockly.
Ask IT about hosting the public folder on a school web server. Opening files from disk does not work.
Test the code on an EV3 robot if the class has one.
